• 1:1 / group bodies and encrypted attachments: E2EE; the server stores ciphertext and routing metadata only
• Safety codes: Maodouchat’s own 5-digit groups for out-of-band checks; changes surface as in-chat warnings
• Secret chat: local FLAG_SECURE + blind watermark + redacted notify/export; device-local only, not a two-party protocol; cannot stop external cameras
• Local DB: SQLCipher; sign-out purges this device session per policy
• Push: FCM only; message previews are mostly encrypted placeholders; no vendor push channels
• AI: never reads ciphertext by default; user-triggered and can be disabled; admin audit has no prompts/bodies
• Backups: if server backup is enabled, scope follows the backup notice — not plaintext access
